died.name: Bede
died.cause: to a scribe to whom he was dictating a translation of the Gospel of John
died.last_words: You speak truth, all is finished now. Glory to God.

died.name: Robert Armitage
died.cause: prior to shooting and slightly wounding his wife and then killing himself

born.name: Nicolaus Zinzendorf
born.desc: German religious and social reformer and bishop of the Moravian Church
born.last_words: Now, my dear son, I am going to the Saviour. I am ready; I am quite resigned to the will of my Lord. If He is no longer willing to make use of me here I am quite ready to go to Him, for there is nothing more in my way.

born.name: Alexander Pushkin
born.cause: to his wife, Natalia Pushkina, after being mortally wounded in a duel with Georges-Charles de Heeckeren d'Anthès, who was rumored to be having an affair with Natalia
born.last_words: Try to be forgotten. Go live in the country. Stay in mourning for two years, then remarry, but choose somebody decent.

born.name: John Wesley Hardin
born.cause: killed in an El Paso saloon by John Selman

born.name: Isadora Duncan
born.cause: just before dying in freak car accident The 50-year-old American dancer broke her neck in Nice, when her long scarf became entangled in the open-spoked wheel and rear axle of the Amilcar CGSS automobile in which she was riding.
born.last_words: Farewell, my friends. I go to glory!

born.name: Peter Kürten
born.desc: German serial killer known as "The Vampire of Düsseldorf"
born.last_words: After my head is chopped off, will I still be able to hear, at least for a moment, the sound of my own blood gushing from the stump of my neck? That would be the pleasure to end all pleasures.

born.name: Al Jolson
born.last_words: This is it! I'm going. I'm going.

born.name: John Wayne
born.cause: to his daughter, Aissa Wayne, who had asked if he knew who she was
born.last_words: Of course I know who you are. You're my girl. I love you.
